item.title: Haeundae Light Festival 2026 (Nov 28 – Jan 10): Lighting Ceremony Time, Subway Exit & What to See
item.description: The 13th Haeundae Light Festival (해운대빛축제) runs from Saturday, November 28, 2026 to Sunday, January 10, 2027 at Haeundae Beach (해운대해수욕장) and Haeundae Square on Gunam-ro (구남로). The lighting ceremony is on November 28 at 18:00 on the sand at Haeundae Beach. This year’s theme is “Deep Dive Haeundae.” Everything below comes from the Haeundae-gu district office (Korean only), checked on November 6, 2026.
